libs.note: BH-6159. The reopen lane (bin/reopen-metrics.sh) saves the comments posted around each reopen as the ledger row reopen_reason/"<project> <key>" (saved | no-comment | unreadable), mirrored in state/reopen-reasons/<project>/<key>.json on the hub. The build plan prompt (bin/lib/rb/plan.sh), the triage prompt (bin/run-triage.sh) and the weekly lookback summary read it. Fails open.

knobs.note: 1 = the reopen lane reads the board thread around each reopen and saves it, and the plan and triage prompts carry it. 0 = no board read, no row written or read, no prompt text; the weekly lookback count of reopens stays.
Hours before and after the status-change activity in which a comment counts as the reopen reason. A board with no activity feed uses the reopen day plus and minus one day.
The newest comments in the window that are saved. The row is cut to 3800 bytes by dropping the oldest comment first.
Board reads per reopen-lane run, fleet-wide. Rows over the cap are left for the next run and counted in the run line.
A saved reason older than this many days is not put into the build plan prompt.
Seconds the triage note is reused from state/reopen-reasons/triage-<project>.txt before the ledger is read again. On a failed read a cache under 24 h is used.
